notes: Phase 0B: re-freeze the --cc-check evidence natively on macOS after the Linux VM went away. (1) Enable --with-openssl and --with-gssapi (keg-only brew openssl@3 3.5.9 and krb5 1.22.2 for headers/libs) so that the three already-translated files be-secure-openssl.c, be-secure-gssapi.c and be-gssapi-common.c keep a compiled variant; without them --cc-check can only list those files as unverified. (2) Four macOS portability fixes: makelog ENTER_RX/LEAVE_RX accept GNU Make 3.81 backtick directory quoting (``dir'``) as well as the Make 4.x 'dir' form; po_sync env_c() inherits PATH; evidence_run gains a portable mount-fstype probe (GNU stat on Linux, mount table elsewhere) used by make_evidence cmd_environment; frozen_config runs check-world at -j1 -k -w because Apple's GNU Make 3.81 has no --output-sync. (3) New `install` capture target: macOS /bin/sh strips DYLD_* from the environment of the commands it runs, so make check's DESTDIR=tmp_install staging cannot resolve the staged binaries' absolute install-name libraries and initdb dies with 'Library not loaded: <prefix>/lib/libpq.5.dylib'; populating the real prefix fixes it and compiles nothing. (4) Evidence cycle re-run natively: configure and all 7 captures exit 0; collect closed=True, unverified=0 (1470 variants, 1470 objects, 1345 Po); replay base all ok; check-world exit 0 in 303s with regress suites 77 (failed tests 0, ignored 0), tap files 0 (fail 0, skipped 0), compiler warnings 0, make errors 0; freeze and freeze --verify both clean. platform_exceptions_candidates.json is report-only (234 candidates, 0 approved). No translation content: every file entry is segments_total=0.
